Class AppIotRealtime

java.lang.Object

com.sca4d.iot.api.change.DeviceChangePublisher, com.sca4d.web.realtime.stomp.WebRealtimeSubscriptionPolicy
@Component public final class AppIotRealtime extends Object implements com.sca4d.iot.api.change.DeviceChangePublisher, com.sca4d.web.realtime.stomp.WebRealtimeSubscriptionPolicy
